name: Shooterz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Shooterz.io is a first-person shooter-style iogame. This is war and the only way home is in a body bag or riding high on the top of the leader board. In shooterz.io you win by killing and lose by dying. It's simple, it's deadly, it's fun. Choose different weapons and learn to crouch, jump and hide. In this game, you won't be firing off rounds against a mindless AI opponent. Oh no sir, In this world you'll be head to head with hundreds of other players from around the world. If you think you're good --and I mean really good-- then why don't you prove it by being the most trigger happy killer in the arena and on the leader board? You can prove yourself over and over again in the world of online combat as you take out enemies one by one and two by two. So, go head to head, toe to toe, eye to eye, and trigger to trigger in this thrilling adventure of a game.
